class.name: DataAccess
class.description:
An object of this class defines the number of ROBs selected and from what subdetector[Group] they are selected.
Note that all ROBs from a subdetector or subdetectorGroup can be selected by one DataAccess object.
Note that if nROBDistribution and Subdetector both evaluates to zero, no ROBs are selected.

attribute.name: subDetector
attribute.description: If this value is 0) ROBs from all available SubDetectors (eformat::FULL_SD_EVENT) are selected. 1) in the range [1..0xf] ROBs from this subDetectorGroup are selected. 2) in the range [0x10..0xff] ROBs from this subDetector are selected.

attribute.name: nROBDistribution
attribute.description:
This attribute determines the number of ROB's to be requested. What ROBs can be selected depends on the setting of the subDetector attribute.
The value for nROBDistribution can be configured to be constant, a Root function or a Root histogram, see class dccommon::Distribution.

attribute.name: comment
attribute.description: Optional description of this data access.

class.name: DummyCalStreamTag
class.description: Specifies optional calibration data that can be produced by this step.

attribute.name: comment
attribute.description: Optional description of this stream tag.

relationship.name: calibData
relationship.description: The calibration data (ROBs) that will be produced if this tag is activated.

class.name: DummyROBStep
class.description: An algorithm step that asks for ROI data and burns cpu time.

relationship.name: roi
relationship.description: The ROBs to be collected for this algorithm step.

class.name: DummyStep
class.description: An algorithm using the full event data and burns cpu time.

attribute.name: burnTimeDistribution
attribute.description: Burn time distribution in micro seconds for this step. The burn time values can be configured to be constant, a Root function or a Root histogram, see class dccommon::Distribution.

attribute.name: comment
attribute.description: Optional description of this algorithm step.

relationship.name: physicsTag
relationship.description: The probability that this step accepts the event.

relationship.name: debugTag
relationship.description: The probability that this step sends this event to the DEBUG stream.

relationship.name: calibrationTag
relationship.description: The calibration data produced by this step.

class.name: DummyStreamTag
class.description: Configuration for a stream tag that can be applied by the dummy steering.

attribute.name: name
attribute.description: The name of the stream tag

attribute.name: probability
attribute.description: The probability that this StreamTag will take effect.

class.name: PuDummySteering
class.description:
The PuDummySteering is a dummy implementation of the hltinterface. It is used to emulate the PESA Steering processing when the PESA Steering is not available or not desired.
The PuDummy steering defines a set of algorithms that that are executed sequentially until an algorithm rejects the event or all steps have accepted the event.

attribute.name: resultSizeDistribution
attribute.description: Size in 32 bit words of the HLT result. The result size values can be configured to be constant, a Root function or the value from a Root histogram, see class dccommon::Distribution.

attribute.name: nbrHltTriggerInfo
attribute.description: Number of HLT trigger info words.

attribute.name: seed
attribute.description: This value is used to indirectly seed both std::rand and Root global grandom. If seed is 1) less than zero the PID is used as a seed. 2) greater than zero the value is directly used as a seed. 3) equal to zero the machine time fraction of second (uint32_t in nano seconds) is used as a seed.

relationship.name: steps
relationship.description: The algorithm steps which will be sequentially executed until an algorithm rejects the event or all steps accept the event.
